svg.title: Opening a shoot: from the start screen to the grid

g.text: Opening a shoot: from the start screen to the grid
modified date, a few thousand per call
fetches attributes a file at a time, which on
a USB drive is a seek each. A 5,352-file card
folder took 54 s that way, 33 ms this way.
modified date came with the listing
read only the sidecars the listing saw
and the camera out of EXIF while the file is open
embedded JPEG preview (~30 ms), video frame
grid, and the camera filter fills in as it goes
